thread:
mira.design: Quick review request 1 1 just pushed a 'spotlight strip' variant for first-run that sits above the workspace header. Staging: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/spotlight-strip :eyes:
zara_research: Looks promising. Early lab users liked the short copy but some skipped the CTA thinking it was informational.
lee_frontend: Implementation notes: strip uses role=region and an actionable CTA. Found a focus order bug: when you tab from header the strip receives focus after nav items which is odd.
sam_access: A11y checklist: 1) make CTA a button with aria-label including destination, 2) ensure strip doesn't disrupt skip links, 3) provide an sr-only description for the strip content. Also contrast on small text is 3.7:1.
alex_pm: Reminder on metrics: primary = api-key creation; secondary = sample-open. Let's make CTA explicit about next step. Copy drafts? "Run a sample project" vs "Open sample projects" vs "Try a quick sample".
mira.design: Prefer shorter: 'Try a quick sample' or 'Run a sample'. Which reads clearer on the strip?
devon_devex: For analytics: onboard.spotlight_impression, onboard.spotlight_cta_click, onboard.api_key_created. Include variant and elapsed_ms.
lee_frontend: Will change CTA to <button> and adjust tab index so skip-to-main lands before strip. Also will bump CTA bg to darker teal to hit 4.5:1.
qa-bot: QA found an edge where the strip overlaps the welcome banner on narrow windows. Filing QA-800. Screenshot attached.
mira.design: Thanks. Small copy tweak suggestion: add micro-context after CTA: 'No setup required 1' so users know it won't modify workspace settings. Thoughts?
zara_research: Helpful. Lab participants disliked surprises. 'No setup required' reduces hesitation. Could be SR-only if visual clutter is a concern.
sam_access: If it's SR-only, still expose aria-describedby linking CTA to the explanatory text.
alex_pm: If fixes clear QA, let's launch an experiment: spotlight-strip vs compact-chip vs baseline checklist. Track cohorts for 14 days and evaluate api-key creation lift.
mira.design: I'll update mocks, add SR copy, and post PR for review. Ping me for copy signoff. :thumbsup:
